snippet.title: Aigiina no Yogen: From the Legend of Balubalouk Commercial [1986, FC]
snippet.description: An early Vic Tokai Famicom classic, this one actually almost came to the NES under the name of it's subtitle, The Legend of Balubalouk. Finished prototypes of the NES version exist, but the game never made it into full production.
